analysis.lane_recall: First-lane attributable detections / all cohort positives; not recall of a separately rerun lane. Lanes are mutually exclusive by first saved detection.
analysis.timing: Original frozen observation prices and minute timestamps; no executable-fill interpretation. Complete certified-negative tape coverage is needed for first-crossing/peak completeness; otherwise observed lower bounds only.
analysis.unknown_scope: all originally unknown fixed-panel symbol-days, not only detected movers

discrepancy_policy: Inspect every known discrepancy, including warmup, using saved native rows and official semantics. Classify but never repair frozen prefixes or silently alter the outcome protocol.
label_definition: native regular-session minute high >= exact opening-minute native open * (1 + threshold), regular session half-open interval
reference_policy: Uniform fixed-panel reference audit; archived listing/delisting/symbol/security evidence only. No absence-from-halt implies continuous tradability. Findings cannot retroactively rewrite discovery.

rules.expected_absent: Previously sourced listing/delisting/literal-symbol-era exclusion with no contradicting native price evidence. Absence from bars, tape or halt records alone is insufficient.
rules.inherited: Preserve every original positive, complete-session negative and expected-absent classification, with original evidence strength; never overwrite parent labels.
rules.negative: For an originally unknown and not quality-excluded day: complete hash-verified SIP trade query covering the entire scheduled regular session, exact opening price agreement, every minute accounted for, no unknown price rules, no unresolved bar/tape issues, no eligible print or native high crossing. Documented empty/non-price-forming minutes need no invented bar. Absence of bars alone never certifies a negative.
rules.positive: For an originally unknown and not quality-excluded day: exact opening minute bar and a documented eligible first-timestamp tape print must agree on opening price; a known eligible crossing print must be corroborated by a native bar high in a minute without unresolved issues. Other unresolved intervals do not negate this witnessed lower-bound crossing.
rules.unresolved: Any missing exact open, unverified query coverage, ambiguous first-timestamp opening prices, unresolved condition/price/bar conflict, identity contradiction, or preserved corporate-action quality exclusion not overcome by a locally corroborated positive remains unknown. Never select an authority by convenience.
